title: check-e2e-list
responsibility: Checks that every discovered E2E test file appears in the root test:e2e and test:package scripts and that those scripts do not name missing E2E files.

inputs.name: declaredE2eTests.script
inputs.description: Script command text from which literal test/... .e2e.test.ts path references are extracted.

inputs.name: compareE2eTests.actualFiles
inputs.description: E2E test paths discovered on disk.

inputs.name: compareE2eTests.declaredFiles
inputs.description: E2E path references extracted from the package scripts.

outputs.name: declaredE2eTests
outputs.description: Sorted E2E test paths explicitly referenced in the supplied script text.

outputs.name: compareE2eTests
outputs.description: Sorted missing paths (present on disk but not declared) and stale paths (declared but absent on disk).

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The CLI throws when package.json lacks either required script; file or JSON reads can also fail.
